notes.title: v1.8 Patch and Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711551/687e2ad7ad09fbf8ca4e8cf2597007b25ef43b58.png


 The game will now automatically create a screenshot for your custom level on Steam Workshop.
 Level creator can load your Workshop levels now.
 Added a button in custom level loading menu to view the level in embedded Steam.
 Fixed skin change issues in both level creator loading menu and custom level loading menu.
 Fixed uploading issues in level creator.
 Fixed cloud save file sync issue.
 Fixed random seed input.


Hi everyone! I'm getting a bit busy recently so I've been updating this game very slowly. Since this update is focus on Steam Workshop feature, I encourage everyone to create their own level for other people to play. Hope you guys enjoy it so far!

- Puetsua

 Added background particles toggle.
 Added tool box button to toggle an additional bar to allow more buttons in game.

 Added a button to remove invalid candidates in easy mode.
 Candidate position are fixed in the cell now.

Hi again! Thank you for all helpful feedbacks to make this game better. Still got a lot of improvements to do such as Steam workshop. Stay tuned. :)

notes.title: v1.5 Patch and Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711551/56891698985048fbc8ad1ac7bb72b644ae849780.jpg


 Fixed random level generator, every level can only have one solution.
 Fixed Easy mode option text and image theme in option menu.
 Removed discord button because of inactivity.


Hi everyone, it's been a while since last update. I have to admit it's quite difficult to fix my spaghetti code after many months. Not many of them is readable to me anymore. After I carefully redesigned generation code on paper, and tested with my level solver. I finally refactored it gracefully and fixed the generator. And it also looks better with transparent cells.

It's not a big update but I hope you enjoy the game so far! Feel free to report any bug on the forum if you found it somewhere!

- Puetsua

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711551/d54c517db160629fbaa8b316856907efb4578b49.gif

Hi everyone. It's been a while! 

Sorry that I wasn't able to update the game frequently. I have got a full-time job recently and I have to delay a few updates and fixes. Here is the patch note for version 1.4! 

Patch notes

 Added easy mode to help players go through the game, you can see extra button in the game that will mark all candidates automatically for you.
 Added a feature where you clicked a mark in the bucket will highlight all marks of the type on the level.
 Added some visual effects.
 Changed some colors of cells when they're highlighted.
 Adjusted layouts in option menu.
 Fixed level formation 7.
 Fixed the problem that settings are not saved after closing option menu in the game.


To make the game better, I have to continue to receive feedbacks from you. So don't be shy if you find any problem in the game! You can find me in Official Discord server for Hexdoku, or simply comment on the thread I created in the Steam forum.

Hope you enjoy this little puzzle game. Have fun!

- Puetsua

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711551/7c7014dbe5cb9c932d7b2690e7c8fefa6dc72f97.gif

Patch notes

 Play 2^32 * 3 random generated levels after completing level 13.
 A button to generate candidates for the level when level creator is in playing mode.
 Added a simple option menu to change settings in the game.
 Display level names at bottom right corner when playing.
 A Discord button in main menu.


Discord server
Also a new Official Discord server for Hexdoku is opened! If you like the game and you want to interact with other players or give some feedback, the server is for you!

Thank you all for supporting this little game.

- Puetsua

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711551/18daabc2700ad6ce8833af977eab25beda494c40.gif

Version 1.2:

 Added more detailed explanation in Tutorial levels.
 Right-click is no longer remove marks but highlight affected lines and area.
 Added maximum range and maximum number of cells in Level Creator.
 Added overwrite warning when player saves level in Level Creator.
 Fixed folder creating issue.
 Changed player save file format. Nothing should be affected.


Random level generator, which is requested by players, is in development. And hopefully it should be finished and release next week. Last weeks I joined a game jam and learning new techniques in Unity so I have been working on the game very slowly.

Also a new Official Discord server for Hexdoku is opened! If you like the game and you want to interact with other players or give some feedback, the server is for you!

Thank you all for supporting this little game.

- Puetsua
